name: Documentation improvement / Perbaikan dokumentasi

title: "[Docs] "
labels: documentation
assignees: ""
---

## English

### Documentation location / Lokasi dokumentasi

Provide the file path and section heading, for example `README.md — Quick Start`. / Sertakan file path dan heading section, misalnya `README.md — Quick Start`.

### Problem / Masalah

Explain what is unclear, missing, stale, or misleading. State whether English, Bahasa Indonesia, or both are affected. / Jelaskan bagian yang membingungkan, hilang, usang, atau menyesatkan. Sebutkan apakah English, Bahasa Indonesia, atau keduanya terdampak.

### Proposed wording or structure / Usulan wording atau struktur

Provide a concrete suggestion when possible. Do not paste private or proprietary content. / Berikan usulan konkret jika memungkinkan. Jangan menempelkan content privat atau proprietary.

### Acceptance criteria / Kriteria penerimaan

- [ ] Command examples are copyable and verified. / Contoh command dapat disalin dan sudah diverifikasi.
- [ ] `implemented`, `verified`, `planned`, `proposed`, and `backlog` status labels are accurate. / Status label akurat.
- [ ] Security and local-first limitations remain visible. / Batas security dan local-first tetap terlihat.
- [ ] English and Bahasa Indonesia sections remain consistent when both are affected. / Section English dan Bahasa Indonesia tetap konsisten jika keduanya terdampak.
- [ ] Links and repository-relative asset paths are valid. / Link dan path asset relatif repository valid.

## Safe disclosure / Disclosure aman

Do not include secrets, private keys, `.env` contents, proprietary source, unredacted logs, or unpatched vulnerability details. Use [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for private security reports. / Jangan menyertakan secret, private key, isi `.env`, proprietary source, log yang belum disanitasi, atau detail vulnerability yang belum ditambal. Gunakan [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) untuk laporan security privat.
